war_declared.text: The council has voted: {my_faction} will meet {enemy_faction} with steel. I did warn that patience was a virtue.
Blood is spilt on the council's word, and I shall make certain the minutes record who argued for it. Quietly, of course.
Every war is a lesson for those who did not vote. Let us hope the lessons are learned before the banners are.

peace_made.text: {my_faction} and {faction} have agreed terms at last. Peace is a fine thing, though some only discover it after losing.
The treaty with {faction} is signed, and I have already drafted the council's note of thanks. Credit is a matter of record.
{my_faction} is at peace with {faction}. Let it not be said the council cannot bend when bending serves it.

player_joined_my_faction.text: Welcome to {my_faction}, {player}! I always say the council is only as strong as the friends it keeps. Do sit near me.
Ser {player}, your oath to {my_faction} is noted. I shall arrange a seat for you at the next council, if you are willing.
{player} has joined {my_faction} at last. How refreshing to see someone arrive on time for once. Do try not to cause a stir.
I am delighted you chose {my_faction}, {player}. Loyalty of your sort is rarely forgotten in this hall.
{player} now swears to {my_faction}. Lovely. Now we shall see who keeps their word when the votes are close.

player_left_my_faction.text: How curious that {player} found {faction} so much more appealing than {my_faction}. I am sure they had their reasons.
Ser {player}, I shall not blame you for seeking better company. I shall, however, remember the oath you swore to {my_faction}.
{player} has left {my_faction} for {faction}. A lesson for the council, I suppose: oaths are only as good as the purse behind them.
Departures from {my_faction} are never a surprise to me. I simply keep a list, and {player} has moved up it.

player_granted_fief.text: {fief} has been granted to {player}, and the council is pleased with the arrangement. I have no doubt it was a sound decision.
Ser {player}, I see {fief} now answers to you. Do govern it well. Your predecessors' records were never quite so tidy.
{player} was given {fief}. How generous the council is with its favours. I do hope the walls hold better than the promises did.
Congratulations on {fief}, {player}. I argued for you quietly in the hall, though I suspect you already know that.

whisper_alliance_offer.text: Ser {player}, {rival} has been courting {enemy_faction} behind the council's back. Shall we see that the hall hears of it?
{player}, a word in confidence. {enemy_faction} is ripe for a bargain, and {rival} is standing in the way. Interested?
Between us, {player}, I would sooner stand with you than with {rival}. Join me against {enemy_faction} and we both profit.
A small offer, {player}. Ally with me against {enemy_faction} and I will remember who helped when the votes fall.

my_faction_took_fief.text: {fief} has fallen to {my_faction} at last, taken from {enemy_faction} in a fine piece of planning. The council will hear all about it.
The flag of {my_faction} now flies over {fief}. {enemy_faction} will be discussing that loss for some time, I imagine.
{fief} is ours. Credit goes to the council's wise votes, and I shall see that it does not forget who drafted them.

player_took_my_fief.text: {player} has taken {fief}. Brave of them, though I wonder how long a fief stays grateful to a lord who gained it so quickly.
Ser {player}, you took {fief} from my hand. I shall not forget it, nor will the council, I promise you that.
{fief} has changed hands to {player}. A lesson for us all in how quickly a council's promises can be outpaced.
Ser {player}, well played with {fief}. Do enjoy it while the council is still deciding who really holds the deeds.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: Good, {player}. Against {enemy_faction} we are stronger together, and {rival} can watch from the sidelines and wonder why.
Very well, {player}. I accept. Let us see if {rival} is still so confident when {enemy_faction} discovers our arrangement.
I accept gladly, {player}. Speak of this to no one yet. The walls of this hall have ears, and so do certain lords.

encounter_alliance_no.text: No, {player}. I have no wish to be seen beside you while {rival} is still counting favours. Perhaps another season.
I must decline, {player}. Alliances are serious business, and I have a council to satisfy before I bind myself to anyone.
Not today, {player}, and I am sorry for it. {rival} has my ear at present, and a promise to them I cannot easily break.

ambient_chatter.text: Has anyone else noticed the mud around {town} this week? A council meeting in that weather is a test of patience. :)
The road from {village} was clear this morning, which I took as a sign. Good weather makes for better votes, I find.
Merchants in {town} are grumbling about tolls again. Someone ought to put it before the council, and I should be glad to.
Lag again on the eastern road, I see. Still, a quiet server gives a man time to think about who sits where at the next council.
